name: loaded-hull-capture-and-trunk-feedback-v1
hypothesis: Initial forward hip-reference progression, near-limit ankles and unbraked forward trunk/CoM motion contribute to early loss of balance; not a proven unique cause.

phases.transfer: A36 posture reference held for 480 native steps (2s), while state feedback changes joint commands
phases.continuation: Then the existing source steps36..1920, with the same continuous feedback; standing reference at absolute9s, source complete at10s; final hold to26s

feedback.horizontalComVelocity: sqrt(9.81/max(height,0.2))*(current loaded hull vertex centroid - CoM horizontal position) - measured CoM horizontal velocity
feedback.verticalComVelocity: 2*(reference CoM height - measured height) - measured vertical velocity
feedback.trunkAndFootAngularVelocity: 2*rotation error toward world upright/flat - measured angular velocity

contacts: Current loaded foot contacts >=3N rebuilt every decision. Soft velocity guidance only, no retained-anchor persistence requirement. Empty support allowed as a diagnostic state.
actuation: Only 46 joint references with exact coherent finite-difference velocities, existing ForceBased installer and unchanged anatomical/aggregate torque limits. No ideal torque model or external root action.
